text:
maria: incident-bot paged me for HIGH inference-queue-p95 (eu-west1) 09:12 UTC — queue depth up, 5xxs starting. looking into causes.
incident-bot: page triggered: alert=HighInferenceQueueLatency; severity=page; region=eu-west1; count=4
kevin: seeing KV cache evictions spike + GPU utilization at 95%. some models are hitting slow-path quant conv.
sara: started a manual scale up of dedicated-pool-eu by +2 nodes, enabling warmup. rerouting some traffic to fallback-small model (latency tradeoff).
maria: good. if fallback holds please start reducing aggressive batching. observed customer errors ~2 customers reporting timeouts via support.
kevin: digging into kernel selector logs; looks like one host had degraded nvlink performance. marking host for drain.
sara: drain kicked, draining host-03. cache rewarm underway. latency P95 trending down.
maria: handoff in 30m — jamal will take on-call. summary: root cause suspected hw flake causing KV evictions -> queue build -> pages.
jamal: ack, taking over. I'll coordinate customer comms and run through post-ops checklist. assign me if needed.
emily: propose post-ops retro Fri 15:00 UTC. agenda: timeline, root cause confirmation, alert tuning, oncall playbook updates, customer followup note.
maria: action items for post-ops:
  - INF-3421: replace/drain host-03 (kevin)
  - INF-3422: add dedupe/aggregate rule to reduce duplicate pages for queued errors (sara)
  - INF-3423: adjust alert threshold: only page at p95>0.85 for 3m and add suppression for region-wide transient spikes (maria/jamal)
  - INF-3424: customer impact log & notify template (jamal)

sara: sample alert rule to iterate on:
```
alert: HighInferenceQueueLatency
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(inference_queue_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) > 0.85
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: /runbooks/inference-queue
```
maria: also add metric-based dedupe: ignore if same root-cause tag within 5m.
jamal: I'll own the post-ops doc and schedule. creating ticket INF-3425 to track remediation, linking above items.
ops-bot: ticket INF-3425 created and assigned to jamal. due: 2026-03-24
kevin: follow-ups: I'll coordinate hardware replacement and add NVLINK counters to monitoring.
emily: also recommend we add an SLO review item: consider tighter error budget alerts and a non-page warning for elevated p95 before page threshold.
maria: thanks all. jamal please ping #customers if we need to escalate comms. closing primary thread; followups in INF-3425 and post-ops on Fri.
